organizations.publicNote: Film archive and research library in Toulouse. Its digital library provides access to digitized books and periodicals, including the Pour Vous run containing issue N0009 of 17 January 1929.

sources.fullCitation: Jacques Lefebvre. “Une excuse de moins: la France a l’un des plus beaux studios du monde.” Pour Vous, no. 9, 17 January 1929, p. 4. Bibliothèque numérique de la Cinémathèque de Toulouse, Pour Vous N0009. Article and images also reproduced by La Belle Équipe.
sources.title: Une excuse de moins: la France a l’un des plus beaux studios du monde
sources.creator: Jacques Lefebvre

sources.researchNote: The Cinémathèque de Toulouse digital library independently catalogs Pour Vous N0009, dated 17 January 1929, in its digitized periodical holdings. La Belle Équipe provides a convenient page-level reproduction and transcription of the article; it is treated as an access copy, not as the holding institution.
